pages.title: Gear for a Friend
pages.text: An equipped animal helps with cargo, travel or protection.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Tame a calf/non-tusked elephant with Acacia Blossoms, add chest/carpet and sneak-open cargo. Kangaroos accept carrots, weapon/armor and stored plant food. Komodo needs rotten flesh and saddle; spit supports poison resistance/slime.
